name: Busujima Mason Rio
original_name: 毒島 メイソン 理鶯
source: A former soldier. He was once a first class sergeant in the navy and was a member of the Special Extermination Task Force. Even after the military was disbanded, he continues to live as a soldier. Using the base camp as a base, he searches for information within the Chuo Ward and succeeds in recapturing his superior officer from his time in the Special Extermination Task Force, Ansho Iojaku. He is always calm and collected, and shows no weaknesses, with a loyal personality. His cooking skills are at professional level, but he often uses strange foods as ingredients.
